method: Distance-uniform 2 cm robot/straight waypoint reference sampling, full monotone XY DTW, continuous projection onto local matched straight waypoint reference preview segments. Approximate order-aligned geometry, not a time-aligned control error. No shifting, rotation, scale, or start/end snapping.
limitations: The straight reference is a geometric ideal with instantaneous corners, not a dynamically feasible time parameterization.
One contiguous active command interval plus first post-completion pose; excludes three seconds of coast monitoring.
Geometry metric removes timing differences; pose headings and timestamps are retained in robot-trace.csv but not scored here.
YAGSL MapleSim defaults to the 2025 Reefscape arena, not a validated 2026 field.
Simulation is not independent evidence of real-robot physical accuracy.
DTW/local continuous projection is approximate and can hide progress/timing differences.
